Amendment of section 364-A, Act XLV of 1860

2. Amendment of section 364-A,
Act XLV of 1860: -In the Pakistan Penal Code (Act XLV of 1860), hereinafter
referred to as the said Code in section 364-A for the words "age of
ten" the words "age of fourteen" shall be substituted.

Insertion of new section 365-A, Act XLV of 1860

ACT III OF 1990
ACT III OF 1990
CRIMINAL LAW
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1989
An Act further to
amend the Pakistan Penal Code and the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 8th January, 1990]
3. Insertion of new section
365-A, Act XLV of 1860: -In the said Code, after section 365, the following
new section shall be inserted, namely:--
"365-A. Kidnapping
or abduction for extorting proper), valuable security, etc.--Whoever
kidnaps or abducts any person for the purpose of extorting from the person
kidnapped or abducted, or from any person interested in the person kidnapped or
abducted, any property, whether movable or immovable, or valuable security, or
to compel any person to comply with any other demand, whether in cash or
otherwise, for obtaining release of the person kidnapped or abducted, shall be
punished with imprisonment for life and shall also be liable to forfeiture of
property."
